# Chris Jenkins – Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate – Native American Group

> Chris Jenkins is a full-time REALTOR® serving Chesapeake, Virginia Beach, Norfolk and all of Hampton Roads, Virginia. Over $100M in sales, 500+ homes sold, HRRA Circle of Excellence 2013–present. Specializes in home buyers, home sellers and military PCS relocation. Phone (757) 286-7255.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://chrisjenkinsrealestate.com/): About Chris Jenkins, services, client reviews, FAQ and contact
- [Neighborhood guides](https://chrisjenkinsrealestate.com/neighborhoods/): Community-by-community Hampton Roads guides
- [Blog](https://chrisjenkinsrealestate.com/blog/): Buying, selling, VA loan and relocation guides

## Cities
- [Chesapeake, VA](https://chrisjenkinsrealestate.com/neighborhoods/chesapeake/): 7,291 sales in 24 months, median $420,000 – South Norfolk, Riverwalk, Greenbrier, Deep Creek, Great Bridge and more.
- [Virginia Beach, VA](https://chrisjenkinsrealestate.com/neighborhoods/virginia-beach/): 12,010 sales in 24 months, median $405,000 – Green Run, Ocean Lakes, Aragona Village, North End, Sandbridge and more.
